data.location: Thunderbird Road, Glendale (directly across from Banner Thunderbird Medical Center)

data.short_description: Blooms Winery is preparing to reopen with a small wine shop and tasting room in the downstairs Cellar Room in Freeland. The Blooms are bringing the winery back after the buyer closed the business, and they plan to host weekend tastings.

data.short_description: Pegasus Pizza & Pasta plans to open its second location on Roxbury Street in December 2026. The team already has its liquor license and is still working on its health department permit.

data.short_description: Le Pichet owners Michael Chick and Marcel Boulanger are planning a wine bar in the former Andalucia space. The renovation with Babienko Architects will keep the exposed brick and wood floors, and the menu will be short and French-focused.
Harvey's Bagels is preparing to open in West End, according to the company's website. The brand is opening eight locations throughout the region, and opening dates have not been announced.
Harvey's Bagels is preparing to open at Nippers Corner in Brentwood. The location is listed as coming soon, and no opening date has been announced.

data.status: "preparing to open"; "expected to open before the end of 2026"
data.short_description: Owner Patsy Auten is aiming to open The Cauldron, a horror-themed coffee shop, by the end of the year. It will serve specialty coffee, tea, sodas and smoothies, and sell work by local makers.

La Mestiza, a Latin American-inspired café, is opening in Fort Greene with a 12-seat dining area. More indoor seating and outdoor seating are planned for spring 2027, and evening service is planned later.

data.status: "preparing to make its way to Cincinnati"; expanding
data.short_description: Sushi by Bou, an omakase restaurant concept, is expanding into Cincinnati. Founder David Bouhadana said the location will offer three omakase experiences.

data.status: "closing after its final service on November 29"; "close permanently"
data.short_description: Sitar Indian Cuisine announced on social media that it is closing after eight years in Kirkland. No reason for the closure was given.

data.status: "opening its doors in downtown Decatur on December 1"
data.short_description: Chef Leonard Yu, who is behind Omakase Table and Ryokou, is opening a 12-seat handroll bar in downtown Decatur. The menu will focus on freshly prepared temaki.

data.short_description: State filings show new construction of a Little Caesars on West US Highway 90, with an estimated cost of $950,000. Construction runs from December 1, 2026 to December 1, 2027, and no opening date has been confirmed.

data.short_description: Abrikos Euro West Store, a family-owned European and Eastern European grocery, has applied for a beer and wine license at Redmond Court. No opening date has been announced.

data.status: "proposed"; construction expected to finish by December 2027
data.short_description: Lemond Spokane Corp. filed a predevelopment application for an $8 million redevelopment of the former Sears. The plan includes a grocery store, a wholesale market and a food court, and no opening date has been announced.

data.status: Previous owner announced "her last day open"

New owners Garin and Tarah Carpenter plan to reopen the store on January 2, 2027. They will expand groceries and convenience items and are applying for a beer and wine license.

Another Nine plans a six-suite indoor golf simulator facility in a commercial development on Hero Way. TDLR records list an estimated construction cost of $422,500. Construction is set to start December 15, 2026, and finish by March 15, 2027.

Furniture brand Thuma plans a showroom on the first level of the 3700M mixed-use building. The tenant improvement has an estimated cost of $1.7 million. Construction runs from February 15, 2027, to August 1, 2027.

Bee Gee Candy Co. is a bulk and wholesale candy store that served Clementon from 1946 until it closed. The owner announced the closure on Facebook and said it was due to retirement. Customers responded on social media with memories and well-wishes.

data.location: Cummins Station, 209 10th Avenue South, Nashville, TN 37203
data.short_description: Time Mission is an immersive social adventure venue where teams of 2–5 compete in missions, and it has announced its Nashville grand opening. The venue will be the largest Time Mission in the US, with 28 mission rooms. Opening-day presales are available, along with discounts for visits from December 17 to 25.

Grotto Baths is a social bathhouse in Wynwood developed by Nathan Kaplan and Nick Anselmo. It offers a thermal circuit with an infrared sauna, a steam room, a cold plunge, a hot bath and a saltwater mineral pool. The space is phone-free and alcohol-free and includes a 30-person ceremonial sauna.

Le Petit Four, a French bakery based in Wellesley, is opening a second location in Boston's Fenway neighborhood. The bakery is led by Valérie Coullet and her son Romain Bernus. It serves viennoiseries, pâtisseries, breads and drinks.

data.short_description: The Double Standard is a 21+ late-night bar from owners Nick Dedier and Alexa Hazelton, planned for El Dorado Hills Town Center. It will be open Wednesday through Sunday, mostly until 1 a.m. The menu will focus on raw and cold items and charcuterie.

data.location: 4359 Town Center Blvd., Suite 110, El Dorado Hills, CA 95762
data.short_description: Barrel and Bliss is a wine bar that closed permanently. The Double Standard will take over its space.

data.short_description: Teru Teru is a new Japanese restaurant and matcha cafe focused on ramen and yakitori. It is a partnership between Lea Kateloy and the Nagamine family. It will have 49 indoor seats and be open daily from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m.

data.short_description: A TDLR permit shows the sports bar and wing restaurant is coming to The Grand at 249. The $932,629 construction project is expected to start in mid-December and finish after mid-March 2027. The chain has at least 12 locations in Greater Houston.

data.event_date: Not specified (originally shooting for December, hoping to open by Christmas)
data.short_description: Bobby Anderson is bringing back the Magnolia's concept as Magnolia's Cafe in Conway. It will serve plated "meat-and-three" meals instead of a buffet, using the same recipes. It will have about 80 seats.

Developer Steve Ghidella closed Magnolia's at 26th, a longstanding restaurant, after buying it from the Anderson family. The closure happened around the time The Post and Courier reported on his purchase of a nearby property in October.

data.status: no opening date has been made public

Planned features include a spa, a ballroom, an art gallery, restaurants and a Christmas Market.
Franchisee Wei Zhu is opening a second Jacksonville Paris Baguette at Bartram Commons. The café will seat 45. Building construction is expected to wrap up in early 2027.

data.short_description: New York Butcher Shoppe, a butcher, deli and wine shop franchise, is preparing to open in Aiken according to its website. It sells Certified Angus Beef, heritage pork, house-made sausages, seafood and prepared foods. The franchise has locations in 11 states.
The historic Kearny Mesa restaurant closed quietly in early July. It was then bought in August by Philanzo and Michelle King and Garrick Charlton.
The restaurant reopened under new ownership after a four-month closure. Friday nightlife events and weekend champagne brunches are back. The restaurant first opened in 1976.

data.short_description: Business filings show Bar Enzo, an Italian-American cocktail bar from Joe Schinco of Terzo Group, plans a third NYC location in Gramercy. The bar already has locations in Long Island City and Midtown East. No other details have been announced.

data.location: 2295 S. Ridgewood Ave., South Daytona, FL 32119

Jimmy John's has a proposed sandwich shop on Radio Road that is going through permitting. No opening date has been announced. It would add to the chain's existing Naples locations.

ROJI is a Japanese-inspired ramen, sake and bodega concept from Wave Sushi founder Jonathan McKinney. It will take over the former Foxtail Coffee and Kelly's Homemade Ice Cream space in College Park. The menu will include ramen, dumplings and sake cocktails.

data.short_description: Brazilian steakhouse Fogo de Chão is preparing to open a ground-up restaurant at the Avion Park Westshore development. The menu features churrasco cuts such as picanha, along with seafood options.
